Registers a new customer into the Qubriux loyalty platform. On success, Qubriux
creates a customer record, optionally provisions a digital wallet, and returns
the internal customer ID along with a customer-scoped JWT. Call this endpoint the
first time a customer is encountered in your system — typically at sign-up or
first purchase. Supply the app-level customer ID in `customer_info.id` to link
the Qubriux record back to your database for future lookups.
